evidence: The bundle is drawn as a side profile of lying logs. The pale ends are vertical faces seen head-on. The bark bodies show only a 1px highlight on top and no horizontal surface read from above. There is no top band, no front-edge line and no eave shadow. This matches the guide's red side-elevation case, with no top surface visible from above.

The outline is a tinted dark brown (0% neutral), which is good. The end-grain rings use about 4 tones, but the bark is a flat dark mass of only 2-3 tones (L 47, 22, 15) with almost no grain or knots. The piece is visibly thinner and flatter than the reference props.
